tasks.label: Agente: iniciar em primeiro plano (com log)
Reiniciar agente
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name = 'node.exe'\" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*printer-agent*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }; Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AtendePrint' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item printer-agent\agent.log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AtendePrint'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Get-Content printer-agent\agent.log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

tasks.label: Teste final ponta a ponta
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File printer-agent\enviar-teste.ps1; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Get-Content printer-agent\agent.log
